# Zuri Platform — Master Feature & API Index
**Version:** 3.2.0 | **Feature audit:** 2026-07-18 (code-verified) | **Counts re-verified:** 2026-08-05

> ⚠️ **Feature statuses below are code-verified, not aspirational.** A prior version of this
> doc marked every feature "✅ live" — that over-claimed. This revision reflects what the code
> actually does. After the feature-completion sprints (FC-01…09, #87/#88), the current
> state is **23 live · 2 partial · 0 mislabeled** (up from 13/11/1 at first audit). See
> the per-feature notes in §1 and the mostly-closed cross-cutting gaps in §1b.

## 0. 🔴 Read this before trusting anything below

**Production is running in hardcoded demo mode (FEAT-031).** `isClientDemoMode()` in
`src/lib/demoData.js` returns `true` unconditionally — no env flag. Inbox, CRM child routes, and
POS tables/cashier serve fixtures from `src/lib/presentationDemo.js`, not tenant data. A feature
marked ✅ live here means *the code path exists and was verified*, **not** that the current
deployment is exercising it. See `CRITICAL_FACTS.md` and
`gks/phase2_atomic/FEAT--presentation-demo-coverage.md`.

**Login brute-force protection is off.** `checkLoginRateLimit()` runs fail-open since the
2026-07-20 Redis incident (`gks/06_incidents/INC-2026-07-20-redis-deleted-login-lockout.md`).
Restore checklist: `docs/INTEGRATION-CHECKLISTS.md` §0.

## 1b. Cross-cutting gaps (the recurring patterns)

The audit surfaced a few themes that span multiple features — worth fixing as shared work rather than per-feature. After the FC sprints, most are closed:

1. ✅ **CLOSED (FC-02 + C4a).** ~~PDF generation is broken app-wide.~~ On-demand PDF generation works via an in-process `pdfkit` renderer (`src/lib/pdf/generate.js`): `GET /invoices/[id]/pdf` and `GET /certificates/[id]/pdf` produce real files, and **Thai text now renders** — the Sarabun font (SIL OFL, Thai+Latin) is embedded (`src/lib/pdf/fonts/`, bundled on Vercel via `outputFileTracingIncludes`).
2. 🟡 **PARTLY CLOSED (FC-03).** ~~Workers coded but never enqueued.~~ `auto-tag` (real) is **now enqueued on inbound** (webhooks + reply) → the sentiment pipeline is live. `sync-messages` **remains a stub** (message backfill still dormant → **FC-10**).
3. ✅ **CLOSED (FC-04/05/07/08).** ~~Real backend, unwired/orphaned UI.~~ FEAT-002 Customer-360 card, FEAT-010 daily-brief page, FEAT-020 ask-marketing chat, and FEAT-019 `PatternDashboard` are all now mounted and consuming their backends.
4. ✅ **CLOSED (FC-06/09 + FEAT-017).** ~~"Real-time" not wired on the client.~~ FEAT-024 now has a client Pusher subscriber (`employee-status-changed`); FEAT-017 delivers the AI reply to the customer on **LINE and Facebook** when the tenant opts in (`Tenant.config.agent.autoReplyDelivery`, default OFF), behind a **confidence gate** that uses the **model-provided confidence** (Gemini `{reply, confidence}` JSON, heuristic fallback), default threshold 0.6.
5. ✅ **CLOSED (FC-01).** ~~Integration security gaps.~~ Sage OAuth tokens and Peak API keys are now stored via `encrypt()` (AES-256-GCM) like FlowAccount; Peak's bogus validation domain was removed (now env-gated `PEAK_API_URL`). *(FlowAccount's own encrypt was also silently storing un-awaited Promises — fixed in the same pass.)*
6. 🟢 **MOSTLY CLOSED (FC-11a + FC-11d + FC-11b).** ~~Settings page is mostly placeholder.~~ Now wired: change-password (RMD-E06), **profile edit + per-user language/timezone, notification per-channel toggles, export-all-data XLSX (FC-11a)**, **delete-workspace — owner-only soft-delete + login block + session revocation (FC-11d)**, and **billing — SaaS billing data model + read-side plan card / history / payment methods (FC-11b, ADR-084)**. Remaining: FC-11b's **PSP integration** (self-serve upgrade + card capture — deferred to an own ADR at billing launch; the model is provider-agnostic) and **profile photo** (→ FC-11c, needs file-storage infra).

> These are **feature-completion / hardening** items, distinct from the RMD remediation program
> (which fixed security/data/quality of what already worked). See `RMD-PROGRAM-REPORT.md`.

## 8. 🔴 Known-broken tests (2026-08-05)

`npx vitest run` → **775 pass · 12 skip · 10 fail** across 4 integration suites:

| Suite | Symptom |
|---|---|
| `src/tests/integration/modules/inbox-page.test.jsx` | `Unable to find element [data-testid="conv-conv-1"]` |
| `src/tests/integration/modules/pos-page.test.jsx` | `Unable to find text: Sushi Set A` |
| `src/tests/integration/modules/marketing-page.test.jsx` | expected fetch spy truthy, got `undefined` |
| `src/tests/integration/modules/crm-page.test.jsx` | throws in `beforeEach` |

**Cause: FEAT-031 demo mode, not flakiness.** These suites mock the API and assert on the mocked
payload (`conv-1`, `Sushi Set A`). The pages under test — `pos/page.jsx`, `crm/page.jsx`,
`crm/{customers,leads,segments}/page.jsx`, `marketing/page.jsx`, and `components/inbox/RightPanel.jsx`
— now short-circuit to `presentationDemo` fixtures (`demo-conv-1`, `Salmon Donburi`) because
`isClientDemoMode()` is hardcoded `true`, so the mocked fetches are never made or never rendered.

Fixing the FEAT-031 exit criteria (env-gate the flag, default off) should restore all four suites.
Until then, do not read a green-ish suite total as "integration is fine".

*Separately*, the `vitest-pool-runner` worker-timeout flake is still present — it changes the
**total** test count between runs (769 vs 797 observed on 2026-08-05), so compare pass/fail sets,
not totals.
